correctness.rationale: Final claim: Algorithm 1 Step 3 is undefined on the given allowed first rapid iterate. Eq. (4) gives G_u=(2023/216)rho^3 and G_v=-G_u/4, while u=4v. Hence the residual along the trial line is R+alpha^2 G_u G_v with R=rho((83521/5184)rho^3-1)<0 and G_u G_v<0. Its absolute value strictly increases for every nonzero real alpha. Algorithm 1 permits these factors and initial alpha_0>epsilon, so the fallback is not reached. RESULT.md and SLOGAN.txt were narrowed: the original assertion that this contradicts Lemma 1 without qualification is not supported under Assumption 1's global Lipschitz reading in factor variables (the diagonal Hessian entries v^2,u^2 are unbounded). The witness defeats the algorithm on its advertised inputs and exposes the omitted zero-derivative case even with Lipschitz gradient on any bounded trial box. The packaged exact checker and its recorded output were inspected, not executed; the symbolic inequality was checked directly.
